    Church Calendar · 2027

    The year of prayer: feasts, Sundays and fasts following the old-style calendar.

    Style: Julian church calendar; the grid uses Gregorian civil dates. In 2027 the difference is 13 days. This is a reference overview of the cited external calendars; it does not establish a binding rule for this community. Please confirm local practice directly.

    Sources and verified dates

    Pascha is on 2 May 2027; Palm Sunday on 25 April; Ascension on 10 June; Pentecost on 20 June. The Eve of Theophany is 18 January, checked against the daily page and Azbyka Vera despite an error in Akafistnik’s annual overview.

    Dates checked on 3 November 2026. The available preview of an official 2027 calendar publication (January–August) was also used for cross-checking. This guide identifies fast days without reproducing detailed dietary rules. Full texts, images and daily lives of saints from the sources are not copied.
